title: AI Is a 5-Layer Cake
description: Most people think AI is just a chatbot or a code model. They’re completely wrong. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang breaks down why AI is actually a massive industrial stack—a 5-layer cake that goes all the way down to raw electricity. Here is the secret blueprint of where the real trillions are going. 🚀 #ai #podcast #nextgenai
